notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK checks for ordinary and directed subscription re-evaluation. The scenarios use only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM modules, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. The checks cover ordinary and directed receive-order delivery at the callback boundary and timestamped delivery at the time-constrained grant boundary, including regional attribute and interaction eligibility, the standard Delay Subscription Evaluation switch, and current-subscription filtering. The three DSE-specific pinned Requirements Lab candidate IDs below map to canonical IEEE 1516.1-2025 §8.1.8; the stale exported §8.1.10 metadata is corrected by the resolved RL-252 crosswalk record. The regional timestamped variants additionally use the directly mapped l10-1 candidate for §8.1.10. This remains experimental public-API evidence, not conformance evidence.
